reasons.retrieverToolCall: The Retriever model reads the current ProjectWiki catalog and recent conversation, then generates the next ProjectWiki tool call.
reasons.retrieverFinish: After receiving tool results, the Retriever model finishes recall selection and returns selected / rejected materials.
reasons.retrieverFallback: The Retriever did not complete an executable tool call or finish, so the system falls back to structured search.
reasons.readMaterials: The system reads ProjectWiki pages or source cards selected by the retrieval model for later context assembly.
reasons.toolCatalogSearch: Inside the search tool, the model judges which materials are worth returning for the focused query.
reasons.retrieval: ProjectWiki is deciding whether to recall project knowledge for the current user request.
reasons.context: The curator compresses selected materials into ProjectWiki context that the main agent can use directly.
reasons.indexTurn: After a conversation turn, the indexer decides which content is worth preserving as source cards.
reasons.historyBackfill: During manual or automatic refresh, the system scans historical transcripts and backfills source cards.
reasons.sourceFreshness: The system checks whether existing source cards can still be verified against their original materials.
reasons.repoIndex: The system summarizes repository-level materials into traceable source cards.
reasons.legacyMemory: The system migrates legacy memory records into ProjectWiki source cards.
reasons.index: The indexer is turning raw material into ProjectWiki-managed source cards.
reasons.sourceReconcile: The maintainer reviews whether existing source cards still hold after their sources changed.
reasons.maintain: The maintainer updates wiki pages and conflict records from source cards.
reasons.system: This program step connects model output, file reads, and ProjectWiki asset updates.
